sentences: A pet has an age (number) and a home (text).
note: The type goes in brackets: number, money, text, percent, or another kind.

sentences: There is a pet called Rex whose age is 3 and whose home is "the kitchen".
note: Every property the kind has must be given.

sentences: Say "{Rex} is {Rex's age} and lives in {Rex's home}."
note: Anything in {braces} is worked out and filled in.
A name means one thing: to change it later, use Set or Add.

sentences:
Add 5 to the total.
Set Rex's age to 4.
note: Also: Subtract ... from ..., Multiply ... by ..., Divide ... by ...

sentences:
If Rex's age is more than 3:
  Say "Rex is grown."
Otherwise:
  Say "Rex is a pup."
note: Compare with: is, is not, is less than, is more than, is at least, is at most, is divisible by.

sentences: A pet is old when its age is at least 10.
note: Then you can write: If Rex is old:  or  For each old pet:

sentences:
For each pet:
  Say "{its name} is {its age}."
note: Inside the block, “it” and “the pet” mean the current one.
Or: While the total is less than 10:

sentences:
Say the number of pets.
Say the total age of all pets.
note: A group can be narrowed: the number of old pets.

sentences:
To feed a pet with a treat (text):
  Say "{the pet} eats the {the treat}."

Feed Rex with "biscuit".
note: Prepositions name the roles: with, to, from, for, on, at, by, against...

sentences:
To work out the double (number) of a count (number):
  The answer is the count * 2.

Say the double of 21.
note: Working out may not change anything or say anything.

sentences:
Ask "What is your name?" and let the visitor (text) be the reply.
Say "Hello, {the visitor}."
note: The reply can be text, a number, money, a percent, or yes or no.

sentences:
A child has an age (number) and a friend (pet, if any).
There is a child called Sam whose age is 7.

If Sam has a friend:
  Say "Sam's friend is {Sam's friend}."
Otherwise:
  Say "Sam has no pet yet."
note: “if any” means the compiler makes you check before using it.

sentences: A pet's age is never less than 0.
note: Checked every time a pet's age changes. Also: always.
If it is not true when the program gets here, the program stops and says so.
